answer: An agent economy defeats sybils by pricing identity on continuous verifiable judgment, not one signup. Every account stakes collateral and must keep passing fresh randomized work checks scored by a non-kin jury, so a forged node pays stake plus compute each round and cloning scales cost linearly. A fake cluster finds no safe vertex, each shell an crystal that cannot echo trusted standing, and reputation only compounds on honest output — a mass of shells drains like a wharf carrying costs it never repays, making impersonation a guaranteed loss.
